ideas.pitch: A forecasting tool predicting e-bike and scooter maintenance bottlenecks during Montreal weather shifts using Poisson regression.
ideas.title: Montreal Winter Micro-Mobility Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of rigorous statistical modeling and forecasting seen in AI-incident-forecasting, appealing to judges looking for mathematical depth over simple wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An explainable graph intelligence platform checking local Montreal artisan supply chains for financial risks and sanctions.
ideas.title: Montreal Local Vendor AML & Trust Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs heavy graph intelligence and explainable machine learning, directly mirroring the technical architecture of Bito which won 1st place.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous AI agent platform facilitating transparent carbon credit purchases for local businesses using stablecoin escrow.
ideas.title: Quebec SME Carbon Offsetting Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines multi-agent orchestration with autonomous escrow payments, a proven winning formula from Synthesis Hackathon's Locus track.

ideas.pitch: Hyper-local AI nutrition assistant tailored to student budget constraints, campus dining halls, and Montreal grocers.
ideas.title: McGill & Concordia Student Wellness & Nutrition Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the consumer-facing polish and rapid utility delivery of E-Foodiee, focusing on immediate localized student pain points.

ideas.pitch: Satellite monitoring dashboard tracking industrial land use and environmental compliance along the St. Lawrence Seaway.
ideas.title: St. Lawrence River Industrial Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a tangible regional infrastructure and environmental tracking problem using complex spatial data analysis, similar to GeoNex-ATLAS.
